notes.37: Question 37 was usually well done. Examiners were looking for de plus en plus de gens qui n’ont pas assez à manger . Those who chose to state that he was shocked were expected to include a verb (e.g. il est ) as choqué et révolté on its own was not clear. For Question 38 , candidates had to provide 2 details. Most candidates were able to provide (i) cinq mille bénévoles viennent se joindre à l’Association and (ii) distribuent huit millions de repas . Even though the vast majority of candidates located the correct information for Question 39 , many lost the mark as the addition of est telle after la popularité de Coluche showed that they had not really understood. Question 40 was straightforward and the vast majority of candidates were able to offer the correct answer: Des amis de Coluche décident de continuer son travail.
notes.41: Question 41 was also well answered and most candidates scored the mark for stating ils aident ceux qui n’ont plus rien à entrer de nouveau dans la société en trouvant un emploi. 24 Cambridge International General Certificate of Secondary Education 0520 French (Foreign Language) June 2011 FRENCH (Foreign Language)
